Maria N.: quick summary from today's onboarding sweep for marlin-lite (7B-ish) — ran FP16/BF16/INT8/FP8 profiles across H100/A100 in us-west1 / eu-west1.
Ashok P.: nice. what probes did you run (batch, seq len)?
Maria N.: smallbatch focus: batch=2, tokens/batch=128, seq=1024 steady-state; also microbatch sweep at batch=1 tokens=64. used our eval-suite (qa-squad-deriv + conv-smoke) for quality deltas.
bench-bot: run 1725006789: marlin-lite/precision-sweep — artifacts at https://artifacts.redwood/internal/1725006789
Derek K.: paste top-line numbers? p50/p95 and throughput per GPU?
Maria N.: top-line — H100 (us-west1):
```
FP16: p50=12ms token, p95=38ms token,  tokens/s=540
FP8(e4m3): p50=8.5ms, p95=27ms, tokens/s=760  (~1.4x vs FP16)
INT8: p50=5.1ms, p95=19ms, tokens/s=1250 (~2.3x vs FP16)
Quality (qa EM on eval-suite): FP16 baseline=100.0, FP8=99.7 (-0.3%), INT8=98.5 (-1.5%)
```
Maria N.: A100 (eu-west1):
```
FP16: p50=18ms, p95=56ms, tokens/s=360
FP8: p50=14ms, p95=44ms, tokens/s=470 (~1.3x)
INT8: p50=12ms, p95=42ms, tokens/s=520 (~1.44x)
Quality: FP8 -0.4%, INT8 -1.8%
```
Jing W.: interesting that INT8 speedup is much less on A100. kernel / matmul path differences?
Maria N.: yeah, kernel selector picked different GEMM kernels; on H100 we hit the fused-int8 fast path. on A100 fallback to slower int8 matmul + reorder.
Ashok P.: did you try hybrid profile (FP8 weights + FP16 activations) or K-split configs?
Maria N.: ran hybrid FP8@weights/FP16@activations for H100: tokens/s=920 (~1.7x FP16) quality -0.15% — good middle ground.
Derek K.: can you paste the exact qprofile names and kernel hints you used? we'll need to pin for Dedicated.
Maria N.: qprofiles: default-fp16, bf16-safe (not used here), int8-symmetric, fp8-e4m3, fp8-hybrid-wA_fp16A. kernel hints: --kernel-prefer=fast-int8 (H100), --kernel-prefer=compat (A100).
Maria N.: bench command snippet:
```
./run_bench --model marlin-lite --profile int8-symmetric --device h100 --region us-west1 --batch 2 --seq 1024 --eval qa-squad-deriv
```
bench-bot: artifacts: s3://bench-artifacts/1725006789/{h100,a100}/{fp16,fp8,int8}/
Jing W.: region diff: eu-west1 showed p95 inflation for small batches (A100 hvd noisy?) — likely ICX host kernel scheduling. we should re-run eu-west1 on isolated hosts.
Ashok P.: what about memory headroom and cache behavior? INT8 gives KV reduction right?
Maria N.: INT8 reduced KV memory ~2.8x; H100 had extra headroom allowing larger batch parallelism; A100 memory saving present but kernel swap reduced perf.
Derek K.: for rollout: suggestion => H100: enable int8-symmetric with fp8-hybrid fallback; A100: prefer fp8-hybrid for production, int8 only on selected pinned hosts after kernel tuning.
Maria N.: agree. I'll open a small PR to add rollouts and per-region kernel overrides. also adding evaluation gating: if qa EM drop >1.0% block auto-rollout.
bench-bot: regression alert check: INT8 on A100 eu-west1 delta EM -1.8% -> flagged
Jing W.: can we try int8 asymmetric quant + outlier clamp? might regain 0.5-0.7% quality.
Maria N.: scheduled a follow-up sweep with int8-asym + clamp + kernel-tweak on A100 eu-west for tomorrow. will post results.
Derek K.: thx. can you include cost calc (tokens/sec * instance price) for Hosted pricing model so we can estimate unit cost delta?
Maria N.: will include cost table in follow-up. quick crude: H100 INT8 tokens/s1250, H100 spot= $6/hr -> 1250*3600=4.5M tokens/hr -> ~ $1.33 per million tokens vs FP16 ~ $2.67 per million (very rough).
Ashok P.: perfect. tag me when you post the artifacts.
Maria N.: will do, thanks! :rocket:
